pinterest.title: Wedding Destinations in November for Autumn or Spring
pinterest.description: For a wedding abroad, November comes down to a choice of hemisphere. North of the equator it is late autumn, as southern Europe winds down its season. South of it, New Zealand is in late spring, while Fiji, Mauritius, the Seychelles and Bali are in their wet, cyclone or monsoon seasons. Our guide covers ten unranked wedding destinations in November, each with its weather, its trade-off and the questions to ask before guests book.

pinterest.title: Wedding Destinations in November for a Quieter European Coast
pinterest.description: Late autumn suits couples who like a place once the crowds have gone. Our November guide covers the Greek islands, the Amalfi Coast, the French Riviera and Portugal at the close of their season, with shorter days and cooler nights. Ask each venue, in writing, whether it is open on your date, which rooms are heated and how many guests they seat, and plan an early afternoon ceremony to keep photographs in daylight. Read the full guide.

instagram_carousel.caption:
Which November are you booking? For a wedding abroad, the month comes down to a choice of hemisphere.

Our new guide, Wedding Destinations in November for Autumn or Spring, covers ten unranked places we plan weddings in, grouped by what November actually is in each.

Late autumn in the north
The Greek islands, the Amalfi Coast, the French Riviera and Portugal are at the close of their season. Expect quieter coasts, shorter days and cooler nights, with venues that may be preparing for winter. Hawaii sits in the northern tropics, where November falls in the wetter winter season.

Spring and island warmth in the south
New Zealand is in late spring, with weather that can be settled one week and wild the next. Fiji, Mauritius and the Seychelles enter the cyclone or monsoon season Smartraveller describes, and Bali is inside its wet season, so a November date there means planning for weather rather than hoping against it.

Questions worth asking any venue
Is the venue open on our date, and will the full team be working?
Which covered space seats every guest, and how late can the ceremony move there?
What happens to deposits already paid if the weather moves the date?

Torn between a quiet Mediterranean terrace and a warm island? Message us to weigh them against your guest list with a Wedded Advisor. Full guide at the link in bio.
